title: POST https://api-ar-game.bistudio.com/game-api/api/v1.0/userProfiles/getMetadata
$comment: Reached by probing the API directly rather than by watching a game: no captured dedicated-server run ever calls it. POST reaches the handler - GET answers 404 `There is no Msg handler for 'GET /api/v1.0/userProfiles/getMetadata'` - and the request fields below are not a guess: the handler's own validation named them (`Field 'userIds' must not be null, found: null.`), and once userIds was present it answered `accessToken can't be empty`, so both are required. No successful call was made, because the accessToken this endpoint wants is a user access token and neither the dedicated server's owner token nor the game client's own owner token is accepted - both answered `Unsupported accessToken type`. The answer is therefore unobserved; what the binary says about it is that GameApiListGetUserMetadataResponse expands into UserMetadata, whose RTTI names a nested Platform struct, so platform data is what this call is for. docs/en/ArmaReforger_BackendAPI_EN.md section 5 records what an identity can and cannot be resolved to.

userIds.description: The identities to look up. The field is `userIds` and not `users`: a body carrying `users` was answered with `Field 'userIds' must not be null, found: null.`

accessToken.description: A user access token, not the server's: the owner token a dedicated server holds is rejected with `Unsupported accessToken type`, and so is the game client's own owner token, whose payload says ownerType GameIdentity.

response.description: **Never observed.** GameApiListGetUserMetadataResponse expands into UserMetadata with a nested Platform struct, so this is where an identity would be resolved to a platform; the field names and the shape are unknown.
